name: Attr
doc: Attr inherits from Node, so inherits all its attributes.

name: isId
doc: Whether this attribute is of type ID, either because it is declared as such in the DTD or because Element.setIdAttribute() was used. This is a read-only attribute.

name: localName
doc: The part of the name following the colon if there is one, else the entire name. This is a read-only attribute.

name: name
doc: The attribute name. In a namespace-using document it may include a colon.

name: ownerElement
doc: The Element node to which this attribute belongs, or None if it is not used. This is a read-only attribute.

name: prefix
doc: The part of the name preceding the colon if there is one, else the empty string.

name: specified
doc: Whether the value of the attribute was explicitly set in the document, as opposed to being defaulted from the DTD. This is a read-only attribute.

name: value
doc: The text value of the attribute. This is a synonym for the nodeValue attribute.

name: CDATASection
doc: The Text interface represents text in the XML document. If the parser and DOM implementation support the DOM’s XML extension, portions of the text enclosed in CDATA marked sections are stored in CDATASection objects. These two interfaces are identical, but provide different values for the nodeType attribute.

name: CharacterData
doc: CharacterData represents text-like data in the XML document. It is a subclass of Node, and the base class of Text, CDATASection and Comment. Such nodes cannot have child nodes.

name: appendData
doc: Append the string arg to data.

name: data
doc: The content of the node as a string.

name: deleteData
doc: Remove count characters from data starting at offset.

name: insertData
doc: Insert the string arg into data at offset.

name: length
doc: The number of characters in data. This is a read-only attribute.

name: replaceData
doc: Replace count characters of data starting at offset with the string arg.

name: substringData
doc: Return the substring of data of count characters starting at offset.

name: Comment
doc: Comment represents a comment in the XML document. It is a subclass of CharacterData.

name: data
doc: The content of the comment as a string. The attribute contains all characters between the leading <!-- and trailing -->, but does not include them.

name: Document
doc: A Document represents an entire XML document, including its constituent elements, attributes, processing instructions, comments etc. Remember that it inherits properties from Node.

name: createAttribute
doc: Create and return an attribute node. This method does not associate the attribute node with any particular element. You must use setAttributeNode() on the appropriate Element object to use the newly created attribute instance.

name: createAttributeNS
doc: Create and return an attribute node with a namespace. The tagName may have a prefix. This method does not associate the attribute node with any particular element. You must use setAttributeNode() on the appropriate Element object to use the newly created attribute instance.

name: createCDATASection
doc: Create and return a CDATASection node containing data.

name: createComment
doc: Create and return a comment node containing the data passed as a parameter. As with the other creation methods, this one does not insert the node into the tree.

name: createDocumentFragment
doc: Create and return an empty DocumentFragment node.

name: createElement
doc: Create and return a new element node. The element is not inserted into the document when it is created. You need to explicitly insert it with one of the other methods such as insertBefore() or appendChild().

name: createElementNS
doc: Create and return a new element with a namespace. The tagName may have a prefix. The element is not inserted into the document when it is created. You need to explicitly insert it with one of the other methods such as insertBefore() or appendChild().

name: createProcessingInstruction
doc: Create and return a processing instruction node containing the target and data passed as parameters. As with the other creation methods, this one does not insert the node into the tree.

name: createTextNode
doc: Create and return a text node containing the data passed as a parameter. As with the other creation methods, this one does not insert the node into the tree.

name: doctype
doc: The DocumentType node of the document, or None. This is a read-only attribute.

name: documentElement
doc: The one and only root element of the document.

name: documentURI
doc: The location of the document, or None if it is unknown.

name: getElementById
doc: Return the element with the given ID, or None. Only attributes declared as being of type ID in the DTD or by Element.setIdAttribute() are searched.

name: getElementsByTagName
doc: Search for all descendants (direct children, children’s children, etc.) with a particular element type name.

name: getElementsByTagNameNS
doc: Search for all descendants (direct children, children’s children, etc.) with a particular namespace URI and localname. The localname is the part of the namespace after the prefix.

name: implementation
doc: The DOMImplementation object which created this document. This is a read-only attribute.

name: importNode
doc: Return a copy of importedNode which belongs to this document. The original node is not removed from its document. If deep is true, the descendants of the node are copied too.

name: renameNode
doc: Rename the element or attribute node n and return it. namespaceURI is the new namespace URI, or EMPTY_NAMESPACE if the node does not belong to a namespace. name is the new qualified name.

name: strictErrorChecking
doc: Whether error checking is enforced.

name: DocumentFragment
doc: DocumentFragment is a lightweight container of nodes. It is a subclass of Node. When it is inserted into the document tree, its children are inserted instead of it, and it becomes empty.

name: DocumentType
doc: Information about the notations and entities declared by a document (including the external subset if the parser uses it and can provide the information) is available from a DocumentType object. The DocumentType for a document is available from the Document object’s doctype attribute; if there is no DOCTYPE declaration for the document, the document’s doctype attribute will be set to None instead of an instance of this interface.

name: entities
doc: This is a NamedNodeMap of Entity nodes giving the definitions of external entities. For entity names defined more than once, only the first definition is provided (others are ignored as required by the XML recommendation). This may be None if the information is not provided by the parser, or if no entities are defined.

name: internalSubset
doc: A string giving the complete internal subset from the document. This does not include the brackets which enclose the subset. If the document has no internal subset, this should be None.

name: name
doc: The name of the root element as given in the DOCTYPE declaration, if present.

name: notations
doc: This is a NamedNodeMap of Notation nodes giving the definitions of notations. For notation names defined more than once, only the first definition is provided (others are ignored as required by the XML recommendation). This may be None if the information is not provided by the parser, or if no notations are defined.

name: publicId
doc: The public identifier for the external subset of the document type definition, or None if the DOCTYPE declaration does not specify it.

name: systemId
doc: The system identifier, a URI, for the external subset of the document type definition, or None if the DOCTYPE declaration does not specify it.

name: DOMException
doc:
Abstract base class for DOM exceptions.
Exceptions with specific codes are specializations of this class.

name: DOMImplementation
doc: The DOMImplementation interface provides a way for applications to determine the availability of particular features in the DOM they are using. DOM Level 2 added the ability to create new Document and DocumentType objects using the DOMImplementation as well.

name: createDocument
doc: Return a new Document object (the root of the DOM), with a child Element object having the given namespaceUri and qualifiedName. The doctype must be a DocumentType object created by createDocumentType(), or None. In the Python DOM API, the first two arguments can also be None in order to indicate that no Element child is to be created.

name: createDocumentType
doc: Return a new DocumentType object that encapsulates the given qualifiedName, publicId, and systemId strings, representing the information contained in an XML document type declaration.

name: hasFeature
doc: Return True if the feature identified by the pair of strings feature and version is implemented.

name: DOMSTRING_SIZE_ERR
doc: DomstringSizeErr

name: DomstringSizeErr
doc: Raised when a specified range of text does not fit into a string. This is not known to be used in the Python DOM implementations, but may be received from DOM implementations not written in Python.

name: Element
doc: Element is a subclass of Node, so inherits all the attributes of that class.

name: getAttribute
doc: Return the value of the attribute named by name as a string. If no such attribute exists, an empty string is returned, as if the attribute had no value.

name: getAttributeNode
doc: Return the Attr node for the attribute named by attrname.

name: getAttributeNodeNS
doc: Return an attribute value as a node, given a namespaceURI and localName.

name: getAttributeNS
doc: Return the value of the attribute named by namespaceURI and localName as a string. If no such attribute exists, an empty string is returned, as if the attribute had no value.

name: getElementsByTagName
doc: Same as equivalent method in the Document class.

name: getElementsByTagNameNS
doc: Same as equivalent method in the Document class.

name: hasAttribute
doc: Return True if the element has an attribute named by name.

name: hasAttributeNS
doc: Return True if the element has an attribute named by namespaceURI and localName.

name: removeAttribute
doc: Remove an attribute by name.

name: removeAttributeNode
doc: Remove and return oldAttr from the attribute list, if present. If oldAttr is not present, NotFoundErr is raised.

name: removeAttributeNS
doc: Remove an attribute by name. Note that it uses a localName, not a qname.

name: setAttribute
doc: Set an attribute value from a string.

name: setAttributeNode
doc: Add a new attribute node to the element, replacing an existing attribute if necessary if the name attribute matches. If a replacement occurs, the old attribute node will be returned. If newAttr is already in use, InuseAttributeErr will be raised.

name: setAttributeNodeNS
doc: Add a new attribute node to the element, replacing an existing attribute if necessary if the namespaceURI and localName attributes match. If a replacement occurs, the old attribute node will be returned. If newAttr is already in use, InuseAttributeErr will be raised.

name: setAttributeNS
doc: Set an attribute value from a string, given a namespaceURI and a qname. Note that a qname is the whole attribute name. This is different than above.

name: setIdAttribute
doc: Declare that the attribute name is of type ID, so that the element is found by Document.getElementById(). Raise NotFoundErr if the element has no such attribute.

name: setIdAttributeNode
doc: The same as setIdAttribute(), but for an already retrieved attribute node.

name: setIdAttributeNS
doc: The same as setIdAttribute(), but for an attribute specified by its namespace URI and local name.

name: tagName
doc: The element type name. In a namespace-using document it may have colons in it. The value is a string.

name: EMPTY_NAMESPACE
doc: The value used to indicate that no namespace is associated with a node in the DOM. This is typically found as the namespaceURI of a node, or used as the namespaceURI parameter to a namespaces-specific method.

name: Entity
doc: Entity represents a parsed or unparsed entity declared in the DTD. It is a subclass of Node. Entity nodes are contained in DocumentType.entities and cannot be inserted into the document tree. The name of the entity is its nodeName.

name: notationName
doc: The name of the notation for an unparsed entity, or None for a parsed entity. This is a read-only attribute.

name: publicId
doc: The public identifier of the entity, or None if it is not specified. This is a read-only attribute.

name: systemId
doc: The system identifier of the entity, or None if it is not specified. This is a read-only attribute.

name: getDOMImplementation
doc:
getDOMImplementation(name = None, features = ()) -> DOM implementation.

Return a suitable DOM implementation. The name is either
well-known, the module name of a DOM implementation, or None. If
it is not None, imports the corresponding module and returns
DOMImplementation object if the import succeeds.

If name is not given, consider the available implementations to
find one with the required feature set. If no implementation can
be found, raise an ImportError. The features list must be a sequence
of (feature, version) pairs which are passed to hasFeature.

name: HIERARCHY_REQUEST_ERR
doc: HierarchyRequestErr

name: HierarchyRequestErr
doc: Raised when an attempt is made to insert a node where the node type is not allowed.

name: INDEX_SIZE_ERR
doc: IndexSizeErr

name: IndexSizeErr
doc: Raised when an index or size parameter to a method is negative or exceeds the allowed values.

name: INUSE_ATTRIBUTE_ERR
doc: InuseAttributeErr

name: InuseAttributeErr
doc: Raised when an attempt is made to insert an Attr node that is already present elsewhere in the document.

name: INVALID_ACCESS_ERR
doc: InvalidAccessErr

name: INVALID_CHARACTER_ERR
doc: InvalidCharacterErr

name: INVALID_MODIFICATION_ERR
doc: InvalidModificationErr

name: INVALID_STATE_ERR
doc: InvalidStateErr

name: InvalidAccessErr
doc: Raised if a parameter or an operation is not supported on the underlying object.

name: InvalidCharacterErr
doc: This exception is raised when a string parameter contains a character that is not permitted in the context it’s being used in by the XML 1.0 recommendation. For example, attempting to create an Element node with a space in the element type name will cause this error to be raised.

name: InvalidModificationErr
doc: Raised when an attempt is made to modify the type of a node.

name: InvalidStateErr
doc: Raised when an attempt is made to use an object that is not defined or is no longer usable.

name: NamedNodeMap
doc: NamedNodeMap does not inherit from Node.

name: getNamedItem
doc: Return the node with the given name, or None if there is no such node.

name: getNamedItemNS
doc: Return the node with the given namespace URI and local name, or None if there is no such node.

name: item
doc: Return an attribute with a particular index. The order you get the attributes in is arbitrary but will be consistent for the life of a DOM. Each item is an attribute node. Get its value with the value attribute.

name: length
doc: The length of the attribute list.

name: removeNamedItem
doc: Remove and return the node with the given name. Raise NotFoundErr if there is no such node.

name: removeNamedItemNS
doc: Remove and return the node with the given namespace URI and local name. Raise NotFoundErr if there is no such node.

name: setNamedItem
doc: Add node to the map, using its name as the key. Return the node which it replaces, or None if it replaces no node.

name: setNamedItemNS
doc: Add node to the map, using its namespace URI and local name as the key. Return the node which it replaces, or None if it replaces no node.

name: NAMESPACE_ERR
doc: NamespaceErr

name: NamespaceErr
doc: If an attempt is made to change any object in a way that is not permitted with regard to the Namespaces in XML recommendation, this exception is raised.

name: NO_DATA_ALLOWED_ERR
doc: NoDataAllowedErr

name: NO_MODIFICATION_ALLOWED_ERR
doc: NoModificationAllowedErr

name: NoDataAllowedErr
doc: This is raised if data is specified for a node which does not support data.

name: Node
doc: Class giving the NodeType constants.

name: appendChild
doc: Add a new child node to this node at the end of the list of children, returning newChild. If the node was already in the tree, it is removed first.

name: ATTRIBUTE_NODE
doc: Integer constants for the possible values of the nodeType attribute.

name: attributes
doc: A NamedNodeMap of attribute objects. Only elements have actual values for this; others provide None for this attribute. This is a read-only attribute.

name: CDATA_SECTION_NODE
doc: Integer constants for the possible values of the nodeType attribute.

name: childNodes
doc: A NodeList of the children of this node. If the node has no children, the list is empty. This is a read-only attribute.

name: cloneNode
doc: Clone this node. Setting deep means to clone all child nodes as well. This returns the clone.

name: COMMENT_NODE
doc: Integer constants for the possible values of the nodeType attribute.

name: DOCUMENT_FRAGMENT_NODE
doc: Integer constants for the possible values of the nodeType attribute.

name: DOCUMENT_NODE
doc: Integer constants for the possible values of the nodeType attribute.

name: DOCUMENT_TYPE_NODE
doc: Integer constants for the possible values of the nodeType attribute.

name: ELEMENT_NODE
doc: Integer constants for the possible values of the nodeType attribute.

name: ENTITY_NODE
doc: Integer constants for the possible values of the nodeType attribute.

name: ENTITY_REFERENCE_NODE
doc: Integer constants for the possible values of the nodeType attribute.

name: firstChild
doc: The first child of the node, if there are any, or None. This is a read-only attribute.

name: getUserData
doc: Return the data associated with key on this node by setUserData(), or None.

name: hasAttributes
doc: Return True if the node has any attributes.

name: hasChildNodes
doc: Return True if the node has any child nodes.

name: insertBefore
doc: Insert a new child node before an existing child. It must be the case that refChild is a child of this node; if not, NotFoundErr is raised. newChild is returned. If refChild is None, it inserts newChild at the end of the children’s list.

name: isSameNode
doc: Return True if other refers to the same node as this node. This is especially useful for DOM implementations which use any sort of proxy architecture (because more than one object can refer to the same node).

name: isSupported
doc: Return whether the DOM implementation supports a particular feature, as DOMImplementation.hasFeature() does.

name: lastChild
doc: The last child of the node, if there are any, or None. This is a read-only attribute.

name: localName
doc: The part of the tagName following the colon if there is one, else the entire tagName. The value is a string.

name: namespaceURI
doc: The namespace associated with the element name. This will be a string or None. This is a read-only attribute.

name: nextSibling
doc: The node that immediately follows this one with the same parent. See also previousSibling. If this is the last child of the parent, this attribute will be None. This is a read-only attribute.

name: nodeName
doc: The name of this node, depending on its type; see the table below. You can always get the information you would get here from another property such as the tagName property for elements or the name property for attributes. This is a read-only attribute.

name: nodeType
doc: An integer representing the node type. Symbolic constants for the types are on the Node object. This is a read-only attribute.

name: nodeValue
doc: The value of this node, depending on its type; see the table below. The value is a string or None.

name: normalize
doc: Join adjacent text nodes so that all stretches of text are stored as single Text instances. This simplifies processing text from a DOM tree for many applications.

name: NOTATION_NODE
doc: Integer constants for the possible values of the nodeType attribute.

name: ownerDocument
doc: The Document object to which this node belongs, or None for a document itself. This is a read-only attribute.

name: parentNode
doc: The parent of the current node, or None for the document node. The value is always a Node object or None. For Element nodes, this will be the parent element, except for the root element, in which case it will be the Document object. For Attr nodes, this is always None. This is a read-only attribute.

name: prefix
doc: The part of the tagName preceding the colon if there is one, else the empty string. The value is a string, or None.

name: previousSibling
doc: The node that immediately precedes this one with the same parent. For instance the element with an end-tag that comes just before the self element’s start-tag. Of course, XML documents are made up of more than just elements so the previous sibling could be text, a comment, or something else. If this node is the first child of the parent, this attribute will be None. This is a read-only attribute.

name: PROCESSING_INSTRUCTION_NODE
doc: Integer constants for the possible values of the nodeType attribute.

name: removeChild
doc: Remove a child node. oldChild must be a child of this node; if not, NotFoundErr is raised. oldChild is returned on success. If oldChild will not be used further, its unlink() method should be called.

name: replaceChild
doc: Replace an existing node with a new node. It must be the case that oldChild is a child of this node; if not, NotFoundErr is raised.

name: setUserData
doc: Associate data with key on this node and return the data previously associated with key, or None. If data is None, the association is removed. handler is called when the node is cloned, imported, renamed or deleted; pass None if no notification is needed.

name: TEXT_NODE
doc: Integer constants for the possible values of the nodeType attribute.

name: NodeList
doc: A NodeList represents a sequence of nodes. These objects are used in two ways in the DOM Core recommendation: an Element object provides one as its list of child nodes, and the getElementsByTagName() and getElementsByTagNameNS() methods of Node return objects with this interface to represent query results.

name: item
doc: Return the i’th item from the sequence, or None if i is out of range. Negative indices are not supported.

name: length
doc: The number of nodes in the sequence.

name: NoModificationAllowedErr
doc: Raised on attempts to modify an object where modifications are not allowed (such as for read-only nodes).

name: NOT_FOUND_ERR
doc: NotFoundErr

name: NOT_SUPPORTED_ERR
doc: NotSupportedErr

name: Notation
doc: Notation represents a notation declared in the DTD. It is a subclass of Node and cannot have child nodes. Notation nodes are contained in DocumentType.notations and cannot be inserted into the document tree. The name of the notation is its nodeName.

name: publicId
doc: The public identifier of the notation, or None if it is not specified. This is a read-only attribute.

name: systemId
doc: The system identifier of the notation, or None if it is not specified. This is a read-only attribute.

name: NotFoundErr
doc: Exception when a node does not exist in the referenced context. For example, NamedNodeMap.removeNamedItem() will raise this if the node passed in does not exist in the map.

name: NotSupportedErr
doc: Raised when the implementation does not support the requested type of object or operation.

name: ProcessingInstruction
doc: Represents a processing instruction in the XML document; this inherits from the Node interface and cannot have child nodes.

name: data
doc: The content of the processing instruction following the first whitespace character.

name: target
doc: The content of the processing instruction up to the first whitespace character. This is a read-only attribute.

name: registerDOMImplementation
doc:
registerDOMImplementation(name, factory)

Register the factory function with the name. The factory function
should return an object which implements the DOMImplementation
interface. The factory function can either return the same object,
or a new one (e.g. if that implementation supports some
customization).

name: SYNTAX_ERR
doc: SyntaxErr

name: SyntaxErr
doc: Raised when an invalid or illegal string is specified.

name: Text
doc: The Text interface represents text in the XML document. If the parser and DOM implementation support the DOM’s XML extension, portions of the text enclosed in CDATA marked sections are stored in CDATASection objects. These two interfaces are identical, but provide different values for the nodeType attribute.

name: data
doc: The content of the text node as a string.

name: replaceWholeText
doc: Replace the text of all Text nodes logically adjacent to this node with content, removing the other nodes. Return this node, or None if content is empty.

name: splitText
doc: Split this node into two nodes at offset, keeping the first part in this node and returning a new sibling node with the rest.

name: wholeText
doc: The text of all Text nodes logically adjacent to this node, concatenated in document order. This is a read-only attribute.

name: VALIDATION_ERR
doc: ValidationErr

name: ValidationErr
doc: Raised when an operation would make the document invalid with respect to partial validity. This is not known to be used in the Python DOM implementations, but may be received from DOM implementations not written in Python.

name: WRONG_DOCUMENT_ERR
doc: WrongDocumentErr

name: WrongDocumentErr
doc: Raised when a node is inserted in a different document than it currently belongs to, and the implementation does not support migrating the node from one document to the other.

name: XHTML_NAMESPACE
doc: The URI of the XHTML namespace as defined by XHTML 1.0: The Extensible HyperText Markup Language (section 3.1.1).

name: XML_NAMESPACE
doc: The namespace URI associated with the reserved prefix xml, as defined by Namespaces in XML (section 4).

name: XMLNS_NAMESPACE
doc: The namespace URI for namespace declarations, as defined by Document Object Model (DOM) Level 2 Core Specification (section 1.1.8).
